Lean-value vs data-fitted Om: 0.31115 (frozen) sits 1.8% from this same pipeline's own BAO+SN-fitted 0.31695 (Om_fit) -- close but not identical; the frozen value is not independently re-derived from this data, it is asserted from LeanMaster and merely not rejected by it.

This is a materially STRONGER result than round 1's rejected proposal (pinning a_pot,b_pot to Lean's dark_energy_w0=-1,wa=0 definitions, which measured a matter-free de Sitter point and was correctly rejected by the round-1 skeptic): here the comparison is a real flat-LCDM cosmology (with matter) against the SAME data, using an independently re-implemented chi2 pipeline (decisive_experiment.py), not the harness's own quintessence code.
